classification: fact, mechanism, and hypothesis are separate lists

facts.statement: 1 cm group r01_b00_cuboid_c30000_o50_x50 integrate P95 is 517.297808 ms. The other 143 historical groups passed. This id is outside the new 96-group 2/5 cm matrix and stays failed.
Nine 1 Hz normal windows failed only surface_ms. Medians were 139-145 ms, 101-110 ms, and 112-124 ms for 0, 5, and 20 boxes. Queue age max was 0.03-0.04 ms.

Overload sent 600, observed 523 completions, and left 77 ids at sent_no_receipt. A later boundary pass placed 227 inputs between publish return and callback entry, 13 at QUEUE_FULL, and 330 accepted frames waiting across another integrate. No DDS drop event was stored.
The immediate GetSnapshot recovery query selected a snapshot about 30.4 s old and returned STALE. A query issued after the integrated receipt selected a snapshot about 0.33 s old and returned OK.

On the scored O6 failure's diagnostic rerun, ApplyBatch was the larger fusion child on 30 of 30 samples, and write_loop_ms was the larger ApplyBatch child on 30 of 30. The rerun did not replace 517.297808 ms.

On the instrumented b20_D1 arm, 2 of 30 surface callbacks waited on the store lock for more than 150 ms. The other 28, and the b00_D1 arm, stayed near the no-write band. Cache-hit surface() itself was about 0.003 ms.
The host reported 32 logical CPUs and powersave. The run was not pinned. Integrate runs on one worker thread. The observer executor is constructed with 6 threads.
Formal O5 was not evaluated. Read-view and cache bytes had no ownership attribution, so that resource gate was not evaluated.

mechanisms.statement: SnapshotRepository::get holds the repository mutex and calls ObservationStore::diagnostics, which locks the same mutex integrate holds for the whole update. A read of an existing handle waits for that update.
The subscription callback looks up TF with a 0.1 s timeout and calls store diagnostics before enqueue. The subscription is reliable KeepLast depth 2. The worker queue also rejects at depth 2.
publish_health reads the worker's cached diagnostics under the worker mutex. That call itself does not take the store mutex.
ObservationWorker integrates on one thread. occupancy_grid.cpp has no OpenMP region.

hypotheses.statement: The two long store-lock samples do not account for the scored 101-145 ms surface medians. The historical response has no lock, build, copy, or serialization split, so that residual is not assigned.
The 227 publish-to-callback gaps are not identified as DDS loss. Depth 2 and callback work are a candidate, and this list does not treat that candidate as the measured cause.
If a future 2 cm or 5 cm integrate exceeds its gate, the next split to record is search, probability, setNodeValue, allocation, inner update, and prune. That split was not measured here.
